analysis.title_zh: 模型能否运行于 AWS Trainium？用 torch-neuronx model support Space 查询
analysis.summary: 公告介绍 torch-neuronx model support Space，用于查询 Hub 热门模型能否不经修改运行于 AWS Trainium，并提供自行运行的脚本。此前介绍的 TorchNeuron 是 Trainium 的原生 PyTorch 后端，使 Transformers 可沿用自身建模代码。Space 默认展示按下载量和趋势分数挑选的模型，列出运行结果及分片使用的 Trainium 核心数，适合模型兼容性筛选与迁移前核查；不代表所有模型均已验证。[S1]
analysis.application: 建议：科研迁移时，可先查询候选模型的兼容性，再利用所提供脚本开展自身任务验证；这是迁移建议，并非官方已验证的科研效果。官方明确提供的是热门模型运行情况查询与运行脚本，所给资料未提供具体模型的测试结果或性能提升数据。[S1]
analysis.requirements: 原文明示涉及 AWS Trainium，以及作为原生 PyTorch 后端的 TorchNeuron（torch-neuronx 包）；未明确版本、账号、API、费用或具体部署条件。使用条件见官方文档。

steps.text: 查看 Space 默认打开的 Selected 视图，浏览按 Hub 下载量和趋势分数挑选的模型。
steps.evidence: The Space opens on the Selected view: our own selection of models picked among the top models on the Hub by downloads and by trending score.

evidence: In a previous post , we introduced TorchNeuron, the native PyTorch backend for AWS Trainium (the torch-neuronx package).
With it, Transformers runs its own modeling code on Trainium, as it does on any other device, so any Transformers model on the Hub may run.
The torch-neuronx model support Space answers that question for the most popular models on the Hub.
It tells you whether a model runs unmodified on Trainium, and gives you the script to run it yourself.
The Space opens on the Selected view: our own selection of models picked among the top models on the Hub by downloads and by trending score.
